bull.b: Sustained, high free cash flow (TTM FCF ~$588M, up 53.9%) provides durable financial flexibility. It supports capex for capacity builds, share repurchases, dividends and debt reduction, improving resilience through cycles and enabling reinvestment in growth initiatives without relying on external financing.

bull.t: Strong organic revenue growth and portfolio transformation
bull.b: Very strong organic growth and multiple quarters of >$1B sales reflect durable demand and effective portfolio moves. New products and the EPG acquisition materially lifted sales mix, showing structural market share gains and product-led expansion across data center and infrastructure end markets.

Repeated capacity expansions and new modular liquid-cooling products position nVent to capture long-term AI/HPC cooling demand. Building manufacturing scale and new product platforms creates a durable competitive edge in an industry where integration, scale and supply reliability matter for large data-center customers.

bear.b: Rising tariffs and inflation represent a persistent cost pressure that can erode margins if not fully passed to customers. A ~$100M tariff headwind and sizable inflationary hits reduce incremental profitability and require continued pricing discipline and supply-chain management to protect long-term margins.

bear.t: Weakened profit conversion vs prior peaks
bear.b: Despite revenue growth, net margin compression versus prior years indicates less efficient profit conversion. Lower margins and moderated ROE constrain return generation and leave less buffer for setbacks, making sustained high-investment growth more earnings-dilutive unless conversion improves.

bear.t: Execution risks from rapid capacity ramps and lumpy orders
bear.b: Aggressive facility builds and rapid scaling create execution and supplier-readiness risk. Large, lumpy data-center orders and complex ramps can cause timing volatility, margin dilution during ramp-up, and potential delivery delays that meaningfully affect medium-term profitability if execution slips.
